thread:
Noah (Collections): Heads-up 1 Hypermesh invoice INV-2026-551 ($42,300) is 22 days past due and they've opened a formal dispute claiming a SDK bug caused runaway exports.
Ellen (Acct Exec): I had the customer on the line earlier. They say a background job hit our SDK edge-case, retried, and produced ~400k extra tokens on 3/05. They're asking for a credit memo for the overage portion (~$29k).
Diego (Hypermesh Billing): Confirmed on our side. We ran replay and saw repeated retries due to a 429->5xx loop. We want a good-faith credit while your engineering team reviews. We also offered to move to a smaller plan to prevent recurrence.
Noah (Collections): From Collections POV we need either full payment or a signed settlement (credit memo + payment schedule). If we accept credit, need to document and req AP to issue payment for balance.
Lena (Finance Ops): Flag: any credit impacts AR & rev recognition. We need GL-entries prepped and CFO approval for >$20k credit. Also, do not reverse revenue until credit memo approved.
Priya (Legal): I'll review contract language around service credits and "bug-caused overage". If the SDK bug plausibly caused the usage, we can agree to a one-time credit. We'll draft a settlement memo that includes a waiver of further claims related to this incident and a confirmation of future rate plan.
Ellen (Acct Exec): Customer is open to the waiver. They want an SLA credit and a technical action item: a patch + postmortem. They will sign the settlement if we provide a credit note and a patch ETA.
Noah (Collections): Proposed path: 1) Hold account in active state (no suspension) for 7 days 2) Issue provisional credit memo for $29,140 pending CFO approval 3) Customer pays remaining $13,160 within 10 business days 4) Include one-time waiver + postmortem deliverable. Agree?
Diego (Hypermesh Billing): That works for us. We can pay the remainder today if the provisional credit memo is sent and the waiver/po signed.
billing-bot: Invoice PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-551.pdf (status: disputed). Credit memo draft uploaded: https://billing.redwood.ai/credits/CM-2026-77-draft.pdf
Lena (Finance Ops): I'll need a formal approval ticket. Please fill AR request: AR-551-credit with estimated GL lines. CFO will sign off if Legal & Collections provide settlement docs.
Priya (Legal): Drafted settlement memo and uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/hypermesh-settlement-draft. Key points: credit amount, release of claims for this incident, payment schedule for remaining balance. Please review.
Noah (Collections): Uploaded SF ticket SF-2479 and linked AR-551-credit. Collections will wait 48 hours for CFO sign-off. If no sign-off, we'll revert to standard dunning and suspend keys after 5 days.
Ellen (Acct Exec): Customer uploaded PO and signed statement of facts. They also asked for temporary increased throttles during the patch rollout. Who owns that?
Noah (Collections): Ops can coordinate with Eng but from collections side, we require the settlement to be signed before any permanent rate changes. Temporary allowances OK.
Lena (Finance Ops): Noted. Finance approves provisional credit memo pending CFO signature. Please send final settlement to finance@redwood.ai for quick review.
Diego (Hypermesh Billing): We'll wire $13,160 today. ETA within 2 hours. Sending remittance to payments@redwood.ai.
billing-bot: Payment received: $13,160 via wire (ref WM-8891) 1 processing. CM-2026-77 set to pending_approval.
Noah (Collections): Marking as "monitoring". Collections will confirm CM issuance once CFO signs. Priya please confirm when settlement is signed and we'll finalize AR entries.
Priya (Legal): Signed settlement returned by Hypermesh CFO and counter-signed by Redwood Legal. Uploaded final PDF to Drive and linked in SF.
Lena (Finance Ops): CFO approved credit memo and posted GL reversal. Accounting will issue final CM and update AR. Please allow 1 business day to reflect in ledger.
Noah (Collections): Great. Closing thread after ledger updated. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
